user.title: Set up IPGUARD
user.description: Use the phone number or email registered for your building. Submitting requests a verification code.

data_description.identifier: Use international format, for example +447700900123 (UK) or +33612345678 (France), or your registered email. For UK and French numbers, omit the domestic leading 0 after the country code. Spaces and 00 prefixes are accepted.
data_description.installation_name: A personal name identifying this installation.

verification.title: Verify your account
verification.description: Enter the six-digit code. To request a new code instead, select Request a new code and submit. Codes are never resent automatically.

data_description.verification_code: Keep all six digits, including leading zeros.
data_description.request_new_code: Only selecting this option and submitting sends another SMS or email.

replace.title: Replace an existing installation?
replace.description: IPGUARD reports an existing mobile installation. Replacement can disable the previous mobile app. Leave the option off and submit to cancel.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: IPGUARD authorization is no longer valid. Continue to request a new verification code. Merely opening this screen sends no code.

error.invalid_identifier: Enter your registered email or an international phone number, for example +447700900123 (UK) or +33612345678 (France).
error.invalid_name: Enter a personal or Android device name.
error.invalid_input: Check the account identifier and installation name.
error.invalid_code: The code was rejected. Enter exactly six digits.
error.code_expired: The verification code has expired. Explicitly request a new code.
error.rate_limited: IPGUARD has limited verification attempts. Wait before explicitly trying again.
error.invalid_auth: IPGUARD rejected account authorization. Check your account and verification code.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to IPGUARD. No code has been automatically resent.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this account is already in progress.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Use the same account as this integration entry. Add a different account separately.
abort.invalid_session: Saved account authorization is incomplete. Remove this entry and set it up again.
abort.challenge_missing: Request a verification code before verifying it.
abort.replacement_declined: Replacement was declined. No account was added.

invalid_session.message: Saved account authorization is incomplete. Set up this account again.

invalid_auth.message: IPGUARD authorization is no longer valid. Sign in again through the integration settings.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to connect to the IPGUARD cloud.

unavailable.message: This relay is unavailable. No release request was sent.

busy.message: A release request for this relay is already in progress. No additional request was queued.

outcome_unknown.message: The release may have been sent, but no matching acknowledgement was received. It has not been retried.

release_failed.message: IPGUARD rejected the release request or the connection failed. It has not been retried.

media_unavailable.message: No current incoming video is available.

init.title: Incoming video
init.description: Video requires a Scrypted server and the IPGUARD companion plugin. Door release buttons and incoming call events continue to work without video. Enabling video allows the first RTSP stream request, including a media probe, to answer a current incoming offer.

video.title: Pair Scrypted
video.description: Install the IPGUARD companion in Scrypted first. Leave the URLs blank to use a running Scrypted Home Assistant app or an already configured Scrypted server and Home Assistant’s own address. The Home Assistant app pairs through your existing HA access; leave its username and password blank. Other servers need a Scrypted administrator login, used only for pairing.

data_description.scrypted_url: Optional override. Leave blank for automatic detection. Otherwise use an HTTPS server origin without a path or credentials.
data_description.ha_url: Optional override. Leave blank to use Home Assistant’s address. It must be reachable from Scrypted.
data_description.verify_ssl: Applies to direct HTTPS pairing. Leave enabled for a trusted certificate. Disable only for a Scrypted server whose self-signed certificate you trust.
data_description.username: Leave blank for the Scrypted Home Assistant app. Required with the password for a separate Scrypted server.
data_description.password: Leave blank for the Scrypted Home Assistant app. A supplied password is used only for pairing and is not saved.

error.invalid_video_input: Enter valid server URLs and Scrypted credentials.
error.cannot_pair: Unable to pair. Check the Scrypted plugin, credentials, certificate setting, and connectivity in both directions.
error.cannot_discover: Unable to read installed app information. Try again or enter the Scrypted HTTPS URL and login.
error.scrypted_not_found: No running Scrypted Home Assistant app or configured Scrypted server was found. Start the app or enter the server’s HTTPS URL.
error.multiple_scrypted: More than one Scrypted server was found. Enter the HTTPS URL of the server to pair.
error.ha_url_unavailable: Home Assistant could not determine its address. Enter a Home Assistant URL reachable from Scrypted.
error.scrypted_credentials_required: This server needs a Scrypted administrator username and password. Leave both blank only for the automatically detected Home Assistant app.
